info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Customer Consumer Loan Application-spec
info.description: This API allows financial institutions to submit consumer loan applications for customers by providing the necessary details. It enables users to input essential application data linked to a specific customer, streamlining the loan processing workflow. Typical consumers of this API include banking representatives and loan officers who aid customers in the application process. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance efficiency and improve customer service in loan management.

post.summary: Create a new consumer loan application for a specific customer.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new consumer loan application for the specified customer ID. Upon successful submission, a loan application record will be generated and associated with the customer, enabling further processing and follow-up actions.
